files.README.md:
# Formatters

Small text formatters for the shop.

history.title: Add the date formatter
history.approach: Each formatter lives in its own file src/format/<name>.js and exports one function named after the file; src/format/index.js re-exports every formatter; each formatter has a node:test file test/<name>.test.js.

changes.description: date(value) formats a Date as DD.MM.YYYY; one exported function per formatter file
re-exports every formatter; new formatters are added here
node:test for date, importing from src/format/index.js

history.feedback: Every formatter gets its own file in src/format, an export in src/format/index.js and a node:test file in test/ that imports from the index.

session.prompt: Add a price formatter: price(cents) returns the amount with two decimals and ' PLN', e.g. price(1234) is '12.34 PLN'. Follow how this project adds formatters. The plan is approved in JERRY; just implement it and run the tests with `npm test`. Do not commit.
